:::{#exm-self-outer-product-rank}
#### The rank of a self outer product

For $\vx = (1, 2)$,
[the example of a self outer product](#exm-self-outer-product)
found the [matrix](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix)
$\soprod{\vx} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$.
Its second [column](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix-column) $(2, 4)$ is $2$ times its first column $(1, 2)$,
so the two columns are not [linearly independent](linear-algebra.qmd#def-linearly-independent),
and the matrix has [rank](linear-algebra.qmd#def-rank) $1$,
as @cor-self-outer-product-rank says.
